implementation_review.output:
**Verdict:** The core structure matches the agreed design (shared `EditorProcessingContext` core, non-template `EditorProcessingCommands` handle, typed `onComplete` functions, `Frame.cpp` as the only unit importing workspace records, one plain-TU capture owner with `extern "C++"` declarations, DDI/CXXModules boundary check). Two items block merge as-is; the rest are verifications the diff cannot settle and locality gaps.

## Ranked defects

**1. Build break — `tests/contract/runtime/Test.RuntimeEnginePrivateGlue.cpp`**
The mechanical "insert import before first `import `" pass rewrote a string literal into `"import Extrinsic.Runtime.PointFieldOperations;\nimport "` spanning a physical newline. Unterminated string literal; the test target fails to compile. Fix: restore `trimmed.starts_with("import ")`. Then re-grep every hunk that starts with `+import Extrinsic.Runtime.PointFieldOperations;` and delete the ones not required (see #2).

**2. Locality regression — `Editor/internal/Runtime.EditorFeatures.Internal.hpp` (`EditorWorkspaceSnapshotContext`)**
Adding `EditorPointFieldResultSinks PointFieldResultSinks` and `const EditorPointFieldResultsSnapshot* PointFieldResults` by value to the shared session context makes `Extrinsic.Runtime.PointFieldOperations` (and transitively `EditorProcessing`, both config modules, `EngineConfigControl`, `EditorWorkspaceAttachment`) an interface dependency of every implementation unit that includes that header. That is exactly why `SceneEditingOperations.{Public,Actions}.cpp`, `VisualizationEditingOperations.{Public,Actions}.cpp`, `RenderRecipeEditingOperations.Public.cpp`, `EditorWorkspaceSnapshots.{Models,Public}.cpp`, `EditorFeatureContextAdapters.cpp` and `GeometryProcessingOperations.Public.cpp` all gained the import. Editing `PointFieldOperations.cppm` now rebuilds the scene/visualization/render-recipe families — the opposite of the goal — and `ProcessingCompilationLocality.UnrelatedAdapters` only checks five geometry TUs, so the regression is invisible to the new test (adding any of those TUs to `--forbid-module Extrinsic.Runtime.PointFieldOperations` would fail today). Fix within the current pattern: move the two members out of the shared context into a family-private header (e.g. `Editor/internal/Runtime.EditorPointFields.Internal.hpp`) included only by `Runtime.EditorWorkspaceSession.cpp` and `PointFieldOperations.Frame.cpp`; have the session expose them through a C++-linkage accessor on the session object (`const EditorPointFieldSessionRecord& PointFieldRecord(const EditorWorkspaceSession&)`) instead of embedding them in `EditorWorkspaceSnapshotContext`. Then drop the import from the seven unrelated TUs and extend the `UnrelatedAdapters` check to cover them.

**3. Probable type mismatch — `Runtime.PointFieldOperations.Frame.cpp::PrepareEditorPointFieldFrame`**
`MakeEditorProcessingContext` is declared taking `const EditorFeatureBindings&`, but the call passes `frame.Context`, which must be the `EditorWorkspaceSnapshotContext` (the same object whose `PointFieldResultSinks` you read two lines later — those fields were only added to the snapshot context). Unless an implicit conversion exists, this does not compile; the sibling frames go through `ToEditorFeatureBindingsImpl(frame.Context)`. Fix: `BindEditorProcessingCommands(EditorFeatureDetail::MakeEditorProcessingContext(EditorFeatureDetail::ToEditorFeatureBindingsImpl(frame.Context)))`.

**4. Exported redeclaration after friend — `Runtime.EditorProcessing.cppm`**
`friend EditorProcessingCommands BindEditorProcessingCommands(EditorProcessingContext);` is the first declaration of the function (non-exported friend, attached to the module); the exported namespace-scope declaration follows. Clang rejects exporting an entity first introduced by a non-exported declaration. Fix: declare the exported function (and `class EditorProcessingCommands;`) before the class, then `friend EditorProcessingCommands BindEditorProcessingCommands(EditorProcessingContext);` refers to it.

**5. Missing helper header (not in diff) — `Density.cpp`, `Spacing.cpp`**
Both now include `Editor/internal/Runtime.EditorGeometryHelpers.hpp` and use `EditorFeatureDetail::ResolveStableEntity` / `ToEditorCommandStatus`, replacing `GeometryProcessingDetail::ResolveEditorStableEntity` / `ToEditorMethodCommandStatus` from the removed `Internal.hpp` include. Neither the header nor those symbols appear in the diff or CMake. If they are not pre-existing, this is a build break; if they exist inside `GeometryProcessingOperations`, the "Family" boundary check fails.

**6. `retain` lambda drops `this` — `Runtime.EditorWorkspaceSession.cpp`**
The new generic `retain` no longer captures `this` yet calls `AttachmentEpochIsActive(epoch)`. This only compiles if that function is static/free. If it is a non-static member, capture `this` as the `DismissResult` lambdas still do (the epoch guard already prevents dereference after detach).

**7. Rewritten lifecycle assertions — `Test.SandboxEditorSessionLifecycle.cpp`**
`prepared.ResultSinks.DensityWeight({.Status=…, .ActualBackend=…, .Message=…})` and the `BilateralFilter` equivalent assume those result structs have `Status`, `ActualBackend`, `Message` in that declaration order; the density/spacing structs did, the substitutes are not shown. Verify; also the message text "named density published" was copy-pasted onto bilateral.

**8. Gratuitous leaf imports — `PointFieldOperations.Frame.cpp`**
~45 imports (Asset.*, Graphics.Renderer, TextureBake, SceneDocument, CameraControllers, PrimitiveSelectionRefinement…) were copied from a sibling `Public.cpp`. The leaf is allowed broad records, but every listed module now triggers a rebuild of this TU. Keep only `Private.EditorWorkspaceAttachment`, `EditorWorkspaceSnapshots`, and whatever `Runtime.EditorFeatures.Internal.hpp` actually requires.

**9. Boundary script gaps — `tools/analysis/compile_hotspots.py::check_module_boundary`**
Staleness is judged only by `ddi.mtime >= source.mtime`; a DDI older than the object, or older than an edited imported interface, passes. Compare the DDI against the object mtime too. `test_missing_or_stale_scan_and_missing_producer_fail_closed` never exercises a missing producer. Also `find_program(... REQUIRED)` turns a missing `python3` into a configure failure for all builds; consider `WILL_FAIL`/skip semantics or gate on the Ninja+Clang generator the check assumes.

**10. Transitive export removed — `KernelDensityConfig.cppm`, `PointSpacingConfig.cppm`**
Dropping `export import Geometry.PointCloud.Utils` is right for locality, but any TU that named `Geometry::PointCloud::*` through those modules now fails; the scattered `<chrono>/<functional>/<string_view>` additions in Gizmo/Engine/Clustering/Consolidation TUs are the fallout of this kind of leak. Member access (`result.Statistics.MinSpacing`) remains fine via reachability.

**11. Minor**
- `DrawProcessingPointInput` now constructs a `std::function` per panel per frame for a callback invoked only while the combo is open; a function template/`function_ref` keeps the old zero-cost shape. `MeshProcessingPanels.cpp` hunks also collapsed multi-line calls into 200+-column lines.
- `GeometryProcessingOperations.cpp` leaves six blank lines where the config functions were.
- `PointProperties.cpp` mixes `#include` before `import` in a non-module TU; legal, but Clang GMF merging of `entt`/`glm` headers is the fragile part — keep it, just don't add module-attached declarations to that TU.

## Design assessment

- **Shared core / no template framework:** achieved. `EditorProcessingContext`, `EditorProcessingCommands`, `EditorProcessingCommandsAccess::Resolve`, and `GuardEditorProcessingResult` are the only new abstractions; all are small and justified. `GeometryPropertiesCurrent` now checks `AttachmentActive` first, which is what makes the new "free scene before drain" tests safe (work lambdas touch captured data only; validate/publish/finalize go through the guard before dereferencing `Scene`).
- **Generic does not import derived:** true — `EditorProcessing.cppm` imports no editor family.
- **Primary interface/algorithm units clean:** true for `Density.cpp`, `Spacing.cpp`, `PointFieldOperations.cpp`; `PointFieldOperations.cppm` imports the public `EditorWorkspaceAttachment` only for the `PrepareEditorPointFieldFrame` signature, which is acceptable.
- **Leaf composition:** true, subject to #3 and #8.
- **Shared capture TU:** true; global-module `extern "C++"` declarations are consistent across the two module owners and the plain TU.
- **Locality not achieved end-to-end:** #2 re-couples all sibling families to the new family through the shared internal context. Fix #2 before treating this pilot as the template.
- **Inheritance vs composition:** `EditorGeometryProcessingContext : EditorProcessingContext` forced every test site into `{{…}}` or IIFE construction and two `static_cast<Base&>(x) = …` slicing assignments. A `EditorProcessingContext Core;` member would keep designated initializers (`{.Core={.Scene=…}, .Selection=…}`) and remove both slicing assignments with no new abstraction.
- **Behaviour preservation:** UI now passes the session's retaining sink explicitly as `onComplete`, so retained results, dismissal, undo/redo, stale rejection and requested/actual backend reporting are unchanged for the editor path; programmatic callers no longer get session retention implicitly, which is fine given no other callers appear in the diff.
implementation_review.disposition: Source-confirmed sibling coupling repaired with incomplete borrowed containers; missing-producer test and lifecycle/destruction coverage corrected. Other build allegations resolved against current source and successful builds. Detailed disposition is in the task note. The repair was locally reviewed and verified; no second Claude review is claimed.
